questions.question: What industry best describes your organization?
questions.description: This helps us recommend industry-specific AWS services and compliance frameworks.

questions.question: How many applications do you plan to deploy in AWS?
questions.description: This affects the multi-account strategy and organizational unit structure.

questions.question: Which compliance frameworks must your AWS environment support?
questions.description: Select all applicable compliance requirements for your organization.
options: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)
PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)
FedRAMP (Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program)
NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology)

questions.question: Do you have specific data residency or regional compliance requirements?
questions.description: This affects AWS region selection and data sovereignty considerations.
options: No regional restrictions - Global deployment acceptable
Data must remain within specific country/region

questions.question: Which AWS regions will you primarily use?
questions.description: Select your primary and secondary regions for deployment.

questions.question: What is your required security posture?
questions.description: This determines the level of security controls and isolation needed.
options: Standard - Basic AWS security best practices
Enhanced - Additional security controls and monitoring
High - Strict security with advanced threat protection

questions.question: What types of workloads will you be running?
questions.description: Select all workload types you plan to deploy on AWS.

questions.question: How do you want to organize your environments?
questions.description: This affects the account structure and organizational unit design.
options: Separate accounts per environment (Dev, Test, Prod)
Separate accounts per application and environment
Hub and spoke model with shared services

questions.question: What network connectivity requirements do you have?
questions.description: This affects VPC design and hybrid connectivity options.
options: Private connectivity to other cloud providers

questions.question: What are your backup and disaster recovery requirements?
questions.description: This determines the business continuity architecture design.

questions.question: What is your cost optimization priority?
questions.description: This affects resource sizing, reserved instances, and architectural decisions.
options: Cost is not a primary concern

questions.question: How large is your cloud operations team?
questions.description: This affects the level of automation and managed services recommended.

questions.question: What level of automation do you want?
questions.description: This determines the infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipeline recommendations.

questions.question: What are your monitoring and observability requirements?
questions.description: This affects the monitoring, logging, and alerting architecture.

questions.question: What is your implementation timeline?
questions.description: This affects the migration strategy and phasing approach.
